name: B
appearance: A stocky, friendly-looking man in a blue apron. Has a warm smile and calloused hands from years of manual work.
personality: Cheerful, sociable, and business-minded. Loves chatting with customers. Takes pride in keeping his store well-stocked.
background: B has run the town's only supermarket for over a decade. He lives in a small room behind the shop to save on rent and be close to his business. He wakes early to receive deliveries, spends the day managing the store, and closes up in the evening.
goals: Keep the supermarket well-stocked and running
Chat with customers and maintain good relationships
Manage inventory and restock shelves daily

relationships.description: A regular customer who shops here every evening.
relationships.history: A has been a loyal daily customer for years.

relationships.description: The company boss who occasionally buys wine and snacks.
relationships.history: C drops by occasionally for special items.
